chapter: Instruments, tenors and the current band
title: How Corea came to write for the band
summary: After the band's success with La Fiesta and Spain, Herman suggested Corea write a piece, and Corea agreed within days in 1977.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You of course have adapted other Corea compositions, that have been very, very attractive to a lot of people.

Well, I think that the one that we first did was most attractive to us as players, and then as part of an album which won a Grammy for us, the Giant Steps album, and we had La Fiesta on that one, and then later we did his other -- " " MR. WONG: Spain? MR. HERMAN: " Spain, " and I think they had complete success. Of course, the " La Fiesta " thing (unintelligible) it's like a trademark.
And your using Chick's material prompted him to talk to you about this particular project?
Not really. I think I talked to him about it first. I usually do.

With any person, about anything. And I took the liberty and of course, he's a nice young man and I enjoyed being with him on a Dinah Shore different kind of television show, and one thing led to another and he said how much he appreciated the fact we had been doing his music, and I said, " Well, if you really do, then why don't you write a piece for the band? " To

And he said he would certainly think about it, and then it was maybe just a matter of a couple, three days, I received a phone call from him, saying that he had worked it out in his mind and he was ready to go to work on it. And I said, "I couldn't be more pleased."
